editorial.blurb: Craft Burger is a no-frills window-service spot in Pilsen slinging exceptional smash burgers with crispy fresh-cut fries and genuinely warm service.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the double smash burger or double cheeseburger without lettuce or tomato — that's their signature style — and don't skip the fresh-cut fries, which come with every order.

topDishes.note: Reviewers rave about the perfect seasoning and crispy exterior
Excellent meat-to-bun ratio with ideal proportions
